summary: pores compressible, skeleton intrinsically incompressible; switches to incompressible upon pore closure. Behaves well down to φw ≈ 0.015. Setting φw_r = 0 is numerically poor.
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.1.4.25 Porous Neo-Hookean, p230（4.13）
module: solid (inferred; may be used as porous solid matrix of a biphasic/multiphasic material, inheriting φs_r from the parent)

example.source: pyfebio 0.3.0 默认值，已通过构造验证；数值为占位默认，建模前请按实际工况替换。
example.verified_note: 已在 FEBio 4.13.0 实测：包进 1×1×1 六面体网格、单轴压缩 1% 的算例，terminate normal。该结果只证明此 spec 可被 FEBio 正常读入并收敛，不代表参数取值适用于任何具体工况。
